description: Headers a native SDK sends. A browser sends none of them and is gated on its Origin instead.

X-Feedoback-Platform.purpose: Which gate the request goes through. Without it the request is treated as a browser's.

X-Feedoback-App.purpose: The bundle id or package name, read from the OS. Declared, never verified: a gate the project's owner controls, not a proof.

X-Feedoback-Install.purpose: A random id the SDK stores on first launch. A rate-limit bucket only, so one device in a loop does not cost a whole carrier's worth of visitors. Not an identity and not a secret.

X-Feedoback-SDK.purpose: Which SDK and version. Diagnostic only.
